title: Virginia Governor Spanberger signs Executive Order 22 to slow data-center approvals and convene an AI risk task force
summary: Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger signed Executive Order 22 on September 18, directing state agencies to slow approvals for new data centers, prohibiting executive-branch officials from signing non-disclosure agreements tied to those projects and standing up a dedicated task force on artificial-intelligence risks. The order also requires expedited noise regulations and a review of backup-power systems used by hyperscale sites, framing the move as part of a same-day wave that included a comparable California executive order on AI safety.
